axes: three.js world: +x = along Rua Eduardo Couto (bearing 61.4°), +y = up, +z = towards the street (0 = rear façade, 14.7 = street façade). y = 0 is ground-floor finished level (+12.70 m a.s.l.).
to_blender: Blender glTF import converts Y-up to Z-up as (xb, yb, zb) = (x, -z, y). Apply the same to position/lookAt below; up vector is +y here (+z in Blender).
lens: lens_mm is the focal length for a 36 mm wide sensor (Blender: cam.data.lens = lens_mm, sensor_width = 36, sensor_fit = "HORIZONTAL"). aspect is a suggestion. Interior "hero" views keep verticals level (lookAt has the same height as the eye).
scenes: Each camera lists the GLBs to load: building = building.glb, context = context.glb, unit-<id>-<pkg> = interiors for that unit/package.
